## Documentation Index\n> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt\n> Use this file to discover

all available pages before exploring further.

# Create an eval case

> Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-em
pty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted withou

t executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.



## OpenAPI

````yaml /

ients

DTOs and their original (tokenless) write contracts; every alias response\n carries `Deprecation: true`. New integratio

ame paths — `/projects/{projectId}/scenarios`,\n `/projects/{projectId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}`,\n `/projects/{projectId

rking and are deliberately not documented here. They return their\n original bodies, which spell the owning id `scenarioId` a
nd whose detail\n read carries no execution settings, and every response answers with\n `Deprecation: true` and a `Link`

ription: >-

cription: >-\n Grade a saved server against a publisher's listing requirements:\n Anthropic's connector directory or Ope
nAI's plugin directory. Reported as\n lane status and coverage, never as a numeric score, and excluded from\n `pooledCon
formanceScore`. Deterministic grading is free; model-backed\n experience observations are an explicit opt-in whose model cost

is on
 MCPJam — no credits are consumed — and they can never decide a verdict.
 - name: Registry
 description: >-
Search the scraped MCP directories (Claude, ChatGPT, and any future\n source), list curated/org registry cards, and insta
ll them into a project.\n Install writes a `servers` row and provenance — it does not open a live\n session. There is no
catalog-uninstall route: delete the project server\n instead. Directory reads require a bearer (including minted guest token

s)
 but do not materialize a user. Card/connection reads and all writes are
 authed-non-guest.
 - name: Feedback
description: >-\n Feedback about MCPJam itself (bugs, missing capabilities, confusing\n behavior), sent to the MCPJam

team and kept for 180 days. The
 `send_feedback` MCP tool calls the same endpoint.
